definitions.execution_charge_near: Sum receipt execution_tokens_burnt once per receipt executed on 25 October 2026 UTC, divided by 1e24; excludes transaction conversion charges.
definitions.origin: Transaction origin account attributed to charged receipt; not necessarily beneficial user or ultimate economic payer.
definitions.concentration_pct: Largest named 1 / 3 / 10 origin execution charges divided by full network execution charge; Other origins is the residual, excluded from ranking.
definitions.action_row_overcount_pct: Excess charge from summing repeated receipt execution charges on action rows versus receipt-deduplicated charge, percent.
definitions.prior_origin_return_pct: Accounts with charged receipts on both 18 and 25 October divided by accounts with charged receipts on 18 October.
definitions.incumbent_execution_charge_share_pct: 25 October execution charges attributed to origins also charged on 18 October; supplied executed query output.

checks: All published group charges reconcile to network total within 1e-9 NEAR
Charge shares sum 100 percent within 1e-9 percentage points
Reported missing and inconsistent receipt charge counts zero
Recurrence count and rate reconcile; recurrence account total matches payer query
limits: Dune rounded numeric results checked with explicit tolerances; underlying full-network rows not independently reindexed.
Two selected dates establish account recurrence, not customer retention or organic demand.
No annualization. Gross receipt execution charges are not native supply burn, protocol net revenue or total customer transaction fees.
Incumbent charge share range checked, but not independently recomputed from underlying receipt rows.
